name: Quantum Field Theory 2
description: Path integrals: PI formulation of quantum mechanics and equivalence to Hamiltonian formulation, path integral quantization of scalars, fermions and abelian gauge fields. Renormalization: UV and IR divergences, regularization techniques, renormalization and physical couplings, counterterms and renormalised perturbation theory. Wilsonian renormalization group, Callen-Symanzik equation, computation of beta and gamma functions. Zeros of beta function, scale invariance and critical exponents. Non abelian gauge theories: Fadeev-Popov method, BRST invariance, Feynman diagrams for QCD, beta function and asymptotic freedom, confinement and QCD scale generation. Symmetry breaking: global symmetry breaking, Goldstone theorem, effective field theory of Goldstone, Higgs mechanism and mass generation for gauge bosons, 1-loop effects. Chiral anomalies: 1-loop triangle diagram computation and Fuzikawa method.
